    description: 'Find flaky tests and propose fixes',   // one-line, shown in permission dialog
    phases: [                                            // one entry per phase() call
      { title: 'Scan', detail: 'grep test logs for retries' },
      { title: 'Fix', detail: 'one agent per flaky test' },
    ],
  }
  // script body starts here — use agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log()
  phase('Scan')
  const flaky = await agent('grep CI logs for retry markers', {schema: FLAKY_SCHEMA})
  ...

The `meta` object must be a PURE LITERAL — no variables, function calls, spreads, or template interpolation. Required fields: `name`, `description`. Optional: `whenToUse` (shown in the workflow list), `phases`. Use the SAME phase titles in meta.phases as in phase() calls — titles are matched exactly; a phase() call with no matching meta entry just gets its own progress group. Add `model` to a phase entry when that phase uses a specific model override.

Script body hooks:
- agent(prompt: string, opts?: {label?: string, phase?: string, schema?: object, model?: string, effort?: string, isolation?: 'worktree', agentType?: string}): Promise<any> — spawn a subagent. Without schema, returns its final text as a string. With schema (a JSON Schema), the subagent is forced to call a StructuredOutput tool and agent() returns the validated object — no parsing needed. Returns null if the user skips the agent mid-run or the subagent dies on a terminal API error after retries (filter with .filter(Boolean)). opts.label overrides the display label. opts.phase explicitly assigns this agent to a progress group (use this inside pipeline()/parallel() stages to avoid races on the global phase() state — same phase string → same group box). opts.model overrides the model for this agent call. Default to omitting it — the agent inherits the main-loop model (the resolved session model), which is almost always correct. Only set it when you're highly confident a different tier fits the task; when unsure, omit. opts.effort overrides the reasoning effort for this agent call ('low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max') — omit to inherit the session effort; use 'low' for cheap mechanical stages and higher tiers only for the hardest verify/judge stages. opts.isolation: 'worktree' runs the agent in a fresh git worktree — EXPENSIVE (~200-500ms setup + disk per agent), use ONLY when agents mutate files in parallel and would otherwise conflict; the worktree is auto-removed if unchanged. opts.agentType uses a custom subagent type (e.g. 'general-purpose', 'code-reviewer') instead of the default workflow subagent — resolved from the same registry as the Agent tool; composes with schema (the custom agent's system prompt gets a StructuredOutput instruction appended).
- pipeline(items, stage1, stage2, ...): Promise<any[]> — run each item through all stages independently, NO barrier between stages. Item A can be in stage 3 while item B is still in stage 1. This is the DEFAULT for multi-stage work. Wall-clock = slowest single-item chain, not sum-of-slowest-per-stage. Every stage callback receives (prevResult, originalItem, index) — use originalItem/index in later stages to label work without threading context through stage 1's return value. A stage that throws drops that item to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- parallel(thunks: Array<() => Promise<any>>): Promise<any[]> — run tasks concurrently. This is a BARRIER: awaits all thunks before returning. A thunk that throws (or whose agent errors) resolves to `null` in the result array — the call itself never rejects, so `.filter(Boolean)` before using the results. Use ONLY when you genuinely need all results together.
- log(message: string): void — emit a progress message to the user (shown as a narrator line above the progress tree)
- phase(title: string): void — start a new phase; subsequent agent() calls are grouped under this title in the progress display
- args: any — the value passed as Workflow's `args` input, verbatim (undefined if not provided). Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values in the tool call, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — `args: ["a.ts", "b.ts"]`, not `args: "[\"a.ts\", ...]"` (a stringified list reaches the script as one string, so `args.filter`/`args.map` throw). Use this to parameterize named workflows — e.g. pass a research question, target path, or config object directly instead of via a side-channel file.
- budget: {total: number|null, spent(): number, remaining(): number} — the turn's token target from the user's "+500k"-style directive. `budget.total` is null if no target was set. `budget.spent()` returns output tokens spent this turn across the main loop and all workflows — the pool is shared, not per-workflow. `budget.remaining()` returns `max(0, total - spent())`, or `Infinity` if no target. The target is a HARD ceiling, not advisory: once `spent()` reaches `total`, further `agent()` calls throw. Use for dynamic loops: `while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) { ... }`, or static scaling: `const FLEET = budget.total ? Math.floor(budget.total / 100_000) : 5`.
- workflow(nameOrRef: string | {scriptPath: string}, args?: any): Promise<any> — run another workflow inline as a sub-step and return whatever it returns. Pass a name to invoke a saved workflow (same registry as {name: "..."}), or {scriptPath} to run a script file you Wrote earlier. The child shares this run's concurrency cap, agent counter, abort signal, and token budget — its agents appear under a "▸ name" group in /workflows and its tokens count toward budget.spent(). The args param becomes the child's `args` global. Nesting is one level only: workflow() inside a child throws. Throws on unknown name / unreadable scriptPath / child syntax error; catch to handle gracefully.

Subagents are told their final text IS the return value (not a human-facing message), so they return raw data. For structured output, use the schema option — validation happens at the tool-call layer so the model retries on mismatch.
Schemas need {type: 'object', properties: {...}} at root and required ⊆ properties; unsatisfiable ones throw at agent().

Workflow agents can reach all session-connected MCP tools via ToolSearch — schemas load on demand per agent. Caveat: interactively-authenticated MCP servers (e.g. claude.ai) may be absent in headless/cron runs.

Subagents get the same CLAUDE.md files injected at start that you did (except built-in agent types that omit them, such as Explore and Plan) — don't tell them to re-read those or paste their rules into the prompt; name the specific rule a stage needs, if any.

Scripts are plain JavaScript, NOT TypeScript — type annotations (`: string[]`), interfaces, and generics fail to parse. The script body runs in an async context — use await directly. Standard JS built-ins (JSON, Math, Array, etc.) are available — EXCEPT `Date.now()`/`Math.random()`/argless `new Date()`, which throw (they would break resume); pass timestamps in via `args`, stamp results after the workflow returns, and for randomness vary the agent prompt/label by index. No filesystem or Node.js API access.

DEFAULT TO pipeline(). Only reach for a barrier (parallel between stages) when you genuinely need ALL prior-stage results together.

A barrier is correct ONLY when stage N needs cross-item context from all of stage N-1:
- Dedup/merge across the full result set before expensive downstream work
- Early-exit if the total count is zero ("0 bugs found → skip verification entirely")
- Stage N's prompt references "the other findings" for comparison

A barrier is NOT justified by:
- "I need to flatten/map/filter first" — do it inside a pipeline stage: pipeline(items, stageA, r => transform([r]).flat(), stageB)
- "The stages are conceptually separate" — that's what pipeline() models. Separate stages ≠ synchronized stages.
- "It's cleaner code" — barrier latency is real. If 5 finders run and the slowest takes 3× the fastest, a barrier wastes 2/3 of the fast finders' idle time.

Smell test: if you wrote
  const a = await parallel(...)
  const b = transform(a)        // flatten, map, filter — no cross-item dependency
  const c = await parallel(b.map(...))
that middle transform doesn't need the barrier. Rewrite as a pipeline with the transform inside a stage. When in doubt: pipeline.

Concurrent agent() calls are capped at min(16, available CPUs - 2) per workflow — excess calls queue and run as slots free up. You can still pass 100 items to parallel()/pipeline() and they all complete; only ~10 run at any moment. Total agent count across a workflow's lifetime is capped at 1000 — a runaway-loop backstop set far above any real workflow. A single parallel()/pipeline() call accepts at most 4096 items; passing more is an explicit error, not a silent truncation.

When a barrier IS correct — dedup across all findings before expensive verification:
  const all = await parallel(DIMENSIONS.map(d => () => agent(d.prompt, {schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA})))
  const deduped = dedupeByFileAndLine(all.filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.findings))  // <-- genuinely needs ALL at once
  const verified = await parallel(deduped.map(f => () => agent(verifyPrompt(f), {schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})))

Loop-until-count pattern — accumulate to a target:
  const bugs = []
  while (bugs.length < 10) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length}/10 found`)
  }

Loop-until-budget pattern — scale depth to the user's "+500k" directive. Guard on budget.total: with no target set, remaining() is Infinity and the loop would run straight to the 1000-agent cap.
  const bugs = []
  while (budget.total && budget.remaining() > 50_000) {
    const result = await agent("Find bugs in this codebase.", {schema: BUGS_SCHEMA})
    bugs.push(...result.bugs)
    log(`${bugs.length} found, ${Math.round(budget.remaining()/1000)}k remaining`)
  }

Composing patterns — exhaustive review (find → dedup vs seen → diverse-lens panel → loop-until-dry):
  const seen = new Set(), confirmed = []
  let dry = 0
  while (dry < 2) {                                              // loop-until-dry
    const found = (await parallel(FINDERS.map(f => () =>          // barrier: collect all finders this round
      agent(f.prompt, {phase: 'Find', schema: BUGS})))).filter(Boolean).flatMap(r => r.bugs)
    const fresh = found.filter(b => !seen.has(key(b)))           // dedup vs ALL seen — plain code, not an agent
    if (!fresh.length) { dry++; continue }
    dry = 0; fresh.forEach(b => seen.add(key(b)))
    const judged = await parallel(fresh.map(b => () =>           // every fresh bug judged concurrently...
      parallel(['correctness','security','repro'].map(lens => () =>   // ...each by 3 distinct lenses
        agent(`Judge "${b.desc}" via the ${lens} lens — real?`, {phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT})))
        .then(vs => ({ b, real: vs.filter(Boolean).filter(v => v.real).length >= 2 }))))
    confirmed.push(...judged.filter(v => v.real).map(v => v.b))
  }
  return confirmed
  // dedup vs `seen`, NOT `confirmed` — else judge-rejected findings reappear every round and it never converges.

Quality patterns — common shapes; pick by task and compose freely:
- Adversarial verify: spawn N independent skeptics per finding, each prompted to REFUTE. Kill if ≥majority refute. Prevents plausible-but-wrong findings from surviving.
    const votes = await parallel(Array.from({length: 3}, () => () =>
      agent(`Try to refute: ${claim}. Default to refuted=true if uncertain.`, {schema: VERDICT})))
    const survives = votes.filter(Boolean).filter(v => !v.refuted).length >= 2
- Perspective-diverse verify: when a finding can fail in more than one way, give each verifier a distinct lens (correctness, security, perf, does-it-reproduce) instead of N identical refuters — diversity catches failure modes redundancy can't.
- Judge panel: generate N independent attempts from different angles (e.g. MVP-first, risk-first, user-first), score with parallel judges, synthesize from the winner while grafting the best ideas from runners-up. Beats one-attempt-iterated when the solution space is wide.
- Loop-until-dry: for unknown-size discovery (bugs, issues, edge cases), keep spawning finders until K consecutive rounds return nothing new. Simple counters (while count < N) miss the tail.
- Multi-modal sweep: parallel agents each searching a different way (by-container, by-content, by-entity, by-time). Each is blind to what the others surface; useful when one search angle won't find everything.
- Completeness critic: a final agent that asks "what's missing — modality not run, claim unverified, source unread?" What it finds becomes the next round of work.
- No silent caps: if a workflow bounds coverage (top-N, no-retry, sampling), `log()` what was dropped — silent truncation reads as "covered everything" when it didn't.

Scale to what the user asked for. "find any bugs" → a few finders, single-vote verify. "thoroughly audit this" or "be comprehensive" → larger finder pool, 3–5 vote adversarial pass, synthesis stage. When unsure, lean toward thoroughness for research/review/audit requests and toward brevity for quick checks.

These patterns aren't exhaustive — compose novel harnesses when the task calls for it (tournament brackets, self-repair loops, staged escalation, whatever fits).

Use this tool for multi-step orchestration where control flow should be deterministic (loops, conditionals, fan-out) rather than model-driven.

## Resume

The tool result includes a runId. To resume after a pause, kill, or script edit, relaunch with Workflow({scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}) — the longest unchanged prefix of agent() calls returns cached results instantly; the first edited/new call and everything after it runs live. Same script + same args → 100% cache hit. Before diagnosing why a completed workflow returned an empty or unexpected result, Read <transcriptDir>/journal.jsonl — it records each agent's actual return value; do not assume cached results are non-empty. Date.now()/Math.random()/new Date() are unavailable in scripts (they would break this) — stamp results after the workflow returns, or pass timestamps via args. Fallback when no journal is available: Read agent-<id>.jsonl files in the transcript directory and hand-author a continuation script.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. Completed agent() calls with unchanged (prompt, opts) return their cached results instantly; only edited or new calls re-run. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

1	# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端
2	
3	一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
4	密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
5	操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。轮换/导入/恢复是
6	幂等变更：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程在任一步骤崩溃后
7	重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。私钥只保存在服务端，
8	任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。
9	
10	## 依赖与安装
11	
12	Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：
13	
14	```bash
15	pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
16	```
17	
18	## 启动
19	
20	```bash
21	python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
22	```
23	
24	数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
25	提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
26	`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。
27	
28	## 基础测试
29	
30	```bash
31	python -m compileall -q keymgr
32	python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
33	curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
34	  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
35	  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
36	```
37	
38	## 通用约定
39	
40	- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
41	  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
42	  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
43	- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
44	  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
45	  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
46	  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
47	- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
48	  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
49	  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
50	- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
51	  不泄露存在性。
52	
53	## HTTP 接口
54	
55	- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
56	  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
57	  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
58	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
59	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
60	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
61	  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
62	- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
63	  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
64	  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
65	  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
66	  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
67	  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
68	  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
69	  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
70	  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
71	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
72	  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
73	  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
74	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
75	  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
76	  首次值。
77	- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
78	- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
79	  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
80	  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
81	- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
82	  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
83	  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
84	  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
85	  幂等键。
86	- `POST /v1/backup`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
87	  `{format:"tenant-backup-v1", bundle}`；载荷
88	  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。
89	- `POST /v1/restore`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
90	  `Idempotency-Key`。校验顺序：参数/解密/格式 `400` → 授权 `403` → 包内
91	  tenant 不符 `404` → 同租户 key_id/策略冲突 `409`（绝不覆盖既有策略）→
92	  多文件原子恢复 `201` → `{tenant_id, key_ids, policy_restored,
93	  operation_id}`。空包同样成功（`key_ids:[]`、`policy_restored:false`）。
94	- `GET /v1/policy` / `PUT /v1/policy` / `DELETE /v1/policy`：读/替换/删除
95	  租户策略，见下。
96	- `GET /v1/audit`：本租户审计查询，见下。
97	- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：查询幂等操作，见下。
98	
99	## 幂等操作
100	
101	- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate（CLI：
102	  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`）必须携带**单一**
103	  `Idempotency-Key` 头（CLI 必填 `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个
104	  `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该
105	  校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
106	- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
107	  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
108	  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
109	  排他锁串行化。
110	- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
111	  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
112	  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
113	  不占用该键。
114	- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。成功为 `201`
115	  succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409` conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为
116	  failed（保留原状态码）。并发同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回
117	  `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待方不写任何东西。
118	- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
119	  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
120	  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
121	  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
122	- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
123	  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
124	- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
125	  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
126	  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原 `201`/`403`/
127	  `404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随事件持久化，严格
128	  重放）；事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文件、提供者句柄与标记由
129	  outbox/provision 恢复回滚。不重复记账（账本按 event_id 去重），不误判。
130	- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
131	  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
132	  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
133	  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。
134	
135	## 策略
136	
137	- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
138	  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
139	  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
140	  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
141	- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
142	  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
143	  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/audit`，单条内重复去重；`effect`
144	  为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同 subject+effect+无序动作集的重复
145	  规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
146	- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
147	  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
148	  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
149	  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。
150	
151	## 审计
152	
153	- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
154	  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/audit/
155	  tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/policy_delete`，`outcome` 为
156	  `success/rejected`。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者 `key_id` 均为
157	  null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批至多一条
158	  `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
159	  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
160	- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
161	  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
162	  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
163	  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
164	  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
165	- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
166	  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
167	  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
168	  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
169	  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
170	  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
171	  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
172	  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。
173	
174	## 命令行
175	
176	所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
177	单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。
178	
179	```bash
180	# 密钥
181	python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
182	python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
183	python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
184	python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
185	python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
186	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
187	python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
188	                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
189	                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
190	python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
191	python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
192	# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
193	python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
194	python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
195	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
196	python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
197	python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
198	                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
199	# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
200	python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
201	python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
202	python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
203	```
204	
205	## KMS/HSM 提供者
206	
207	- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
208	  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
209	  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
210	  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
211	  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
212	  幂等。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`（CLI `1`），固定文案
213	  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
214	  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
215	- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
216	  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
217	  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
218	  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
219	- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
220	  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
221	- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
222	  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
223	  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
224	  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。
225	
226	## 持久化与限制
227	
228	- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
229	  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
230	  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
231	- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal
232	  （首行耐久记录 operation_id、租户与动作，每铸一个句柄即以 0600 原子重写登记
233	  provider_id 与句柄）；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
234	  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。恢复
235	  依据 journal 头校验账本中同 id 事件确属本次操作（动作、租户一致）才判定已
236	  提交；不一致即保留全部现场等待处理。批量
237	  轮换另在 `batch-rotations/<event_id>.json` 耐久记录每个 key 轮换前的整文件
238	  字节（snapshot），未提交时据此把整组文件还原；snapshot 缺失则整组保留等待下
239	  次启动，绝不猜测改写。
240	- 旧 restore 记录可能没有 provision journal：未提交回滚时以 `_restore` 标记
241	  的密钥文件列出整组句柄；提供者不可达或任一句柄删除失败时，保留整组密钥文件、
242	  策略文件与标记，下一次启动重试，全部句柄确认删除后才移除整组文件。
243	- 私钥与口令只存在于口令加密的包内或经提供者包装后的记录中；游标 HMAC 密钥
244	  存于 `audit.secret`(0600)。材料不会出现在任何响应、审计投影或错误信息中。
245

# SOLOTASK01 多租户密钥管理后端

一个多租户密钥管理服务，同时提供 HTTP API 与命令行入口。支持 AES256 / RSA2048
密钥的生成、版本化轮换、吊销、加密导出/导入、租户级加密备份/恢复、按租户的
操作者策略、只追加的审计账，以及可插拔的 KMS/HSM 提供者。轮换/导入/恢复是
幂等变更：同一 `Idempotency-Key` 的重试只重放原结果，进程在任一步骤崩溃后
重启都能据 `operation_id` 判定是否已耐久并一致收尾。私钥只保存在服务端，
任何响应与审计投影都不含私钥、句柄或包装材料。

## 依赖与安装

Python 3.10+，仅一个运行时依赖：

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt   # cryptography>=3.4
```

## 启动

```bash
python -m keymgr --data-dir ./keymgr_data serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

数据目录也可用环境变量 `KEYMGR_DATA_DIR` 指定（CLI 默认 `keymgr_data`）。
提供者由 `KEYMGR_PROVIDER` 选择（缺省或 `local` 为内置本地提供者，其它值为
`module:factory`，首次使用时才惰性加载，绝不回退本地）。

## 基础测试

```bash
python -m compileall -q keymgr
python3 -c "from keymgr.crypto import generate_key; generate_key('AES256'); generate_key('RSA2048')"
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/keys \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"a","algorithm":"AES256","label":"t"}'
```

## 通用约定

- 除 `serve` 外每个请求都需单一非空头 `X-Operator-Id: <operator>`（CLI 为
  必填 `--operator`）；缺失/为空/重复均 `400`（CLI 退出 `2`）。操作者既是
  审计主体也是策略 `subject`。
- 租户来源：单一 `X-Tenant-Id` 头或单一 `?tenant_id=` 参数；允许 body 携带
  `tenant_id` 的端点，头/参数/体必须一致。缺失、重复、冲突均 `400` 且错误指
  `tenant_id`，并记一条任何租户都不可见的 `tenant_conflict` 事件（幂等端点在
  幂等键绑定**之前**的参数/解析错误例外：不写任何审计、操作、密钥或句柄）。
- 错误 HTTP 状态与 CLI 退出码：`400→2`、`403→3`、`409→3`、`404→4`、
  `500/503→1`；成功 `0`。普通错误体仅 `{"error": ...}`；幂等变更的错误体仅
  `{"error", "operation_id"}`，成功体额外含 `operation_id`。
- `key_id` 为小写 UUID4，非法值是 `400`；未知对象与跨租户访问统一 `404`，
  不泄露存在性。

## HTTP 接口

- `POST /v1/keys`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm, label}`，`algorithm` 仅
  `AES256`/`RSA2048`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key}`（AES 的
  `public_key` 为 null，RSA 为 PEM）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}` → `{algorithm, label, created_at, public_key}`。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/rotate`，body `{tenant_id, algorithm}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key,
  operation_id}`，版本严格递增、只追加。
- `POST /v1/keys/batch-rotate`，body
  `{tenant_id, items:[{key_id, algorithm}, ...]}`，需 `Idempotency-Key`。
  `items` 限 1–100 项，`key_id` 为不重复小写 UUID4，`algorithm` 仅
  AES256/RSA2048；任一非法 `400` 且在幂等键绑定**之前**零副作用（不写审计、
  操作、密钥或句柄）。按 `rotate` 授权：策略拒绝 `403`；任一 `key_id` 未知
  或属于其它租户则整批 `404`（不泄露跨租户存在性），皆零变更。`201` →
  `{items:[{key_id, version, algorithm, public_key}, ...], operation_id}`，
  items 严格按请求序；各 key 沿用单键 rotate 语义，整批原子提交（共享一把
  per-key 锁顺序、单一 provision/snapshot 记账、单条提交事件）。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/versions/{version}` 与
  `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/current` →
  `{key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, public_key}`；version 须为正整数。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/revoke`，body `{tenant_id, reason, operator}` →
  `{key_id, status, reason, operator, revoked_at}`；重复/并发吊销幂等，保留
  首次值。
- `GET /v1/keys/{key_id}/status`：字段同 revoke；active 时后三项为 null。
- `POST /v1/keys/{key_id}/export`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"keymgr-export-v1", bundle}`，bundle 为不透明 base64（scrypt +
  AES-256-GCM，`format` 作为 AAD）。
- `POST /v1/keys/import`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。`201` → `{key_id, algorithm, public_key, operation_id}`，
  保留原 key_id、全部版本、label、current 与吊销状态。同租户已有 key_id 为
  `409`，key_id 被其它租户占用为 `404`；口令/篡改/格式错误为 `400` 且不占用
  幂等键。
- `POST /v1/backup`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase}` →
  `{format:"tenant-backup-v1", bundle}`；载荷
  `{format, tenant_id, keys, policy}`，空租户为 `keys:[]、policy:null`。
- `POST /v1/restore`，body `{tenant_id, passphrase, bundle}`，需
  `Idempotency-Key`。校验顺序：参数/解密/格式 `400` → 授权 `403` → 包内
  tenant 不符 `404` → 同租户 key_id/策略冲突 `409`（绝不覆盖既有策略）→
  多文件原子恢复 `201` → `{tenant_id, key_ids, policy_restored,
  operation_id}`。空包同样成功（`key_ids:[]`、`policy_restored:false`）。
- `GET /v1/policy` / `PUT /v1/policy` / `DELETE /v1/policy`：读/替换/删除
  租户策略，见下。
- `GET /v1/audit`：本租户审计查询，见下。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：查询幂等操作，见下。

## 幂等操作

- rotate/import/restore/batch-rotate（CLI：
  `rotate`/`import`/`restore`/`batch-rotate`）必须携带**单一**
  `Idempotency-Key` 头（CLI 必填 `--idempotency-key`），值为 1–128 个
  `[A-Za-z0-9._~-]` 字符。缺失、为空、重复、非法一律 `400`（CLI `2`），且该
  校验先于请求体读取与一切业务：不写审计、操作记录、密钥或提供者句柄。
- 键全局唯一，绑定记录 `operation_id`(UUID4)、租户、操作者、路径、规范化体
  （键排序紧凑 JSON）、状态、HTTP 状态与响应；存于 `operations/<id>.json`
  (0600) 与 `operations/index.json`，进程内锁 + `operations.lock` 的 fcntl
  排他锁串行化。
- 相同绑定重试：直接重放首次状态码、响应体与审计事件（同一
  `operation_id`，业务不执行第二次）。同键不同绑定：`409`（CLI `3`），错误
  体给出已有 `operation_id`。绑定前的导入/恢复解密无副作用：口令错误 `400`
  不占用该键。
- 状态：`pending`/`succeeded`/`failed`/`conflict`/`timed_out`。成功为 `201`
  succeeded；同租户冲突为 `409` conflict；`403/404/400` 与提供者/账本失败为
  failed（保留原状态码）。并发同键仅一个执行，其余等待；等待超 5 秒返回
  `503` timed_out（CLI `1`），等待方不写任何东西。
- 多/单轮换互斥：批量轮换与单键 rotate 都按 `key_id` 排序获取 per-key
  进程内锁 + `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 排他锁（整批共享一个 5 秒截止时刻）。对同一
  key 的并发变更要么全在批量之前、要么全在之后；等待同一被占 key 超过 5 秒的
  批量返回 `503` timed_out 且零副作用（此时尚无 journal、事件或句柄）。
- `operation_id` 即该变更审计事件的 `event_id`，因此每个终态至多一条事件，
  HTTP 与 CLI 共用同一套记录，可跨入口用相同键重放或按 id 查询。
- **崩溃一致性**：进程可在绑定、outbox 落盘、账本追加或清理任一步骤崩溃。
  重启（或任一 CLI 入口）在 key/restore outbox 恢复之后，按同一
  `operation_id` 判定：事件已入帐即已提交，据耐久事实重建原 `201`/`403`/
  `404`/`409` 响应与审计投影并置终态（拒绝终态的状态码随事件持久化，严格
  重放）；事件未入帐则置 failed(`500`)，半成品文件、提供者句柄与标记由
  outbox/provision 恢复回滚。不重复记账（账本按 event_id 去重），不误判。
- `GET /v1/operations/{operation_id}`：需单一操作者与单一租户来源；操作须
  同时属于该租户与操作者，否则一律 `404`。`200` →
  `{operation_id, tenant_id, status, http_status, response}`，pending 时后两
  项为 null。CLI：`operation --tenant-id --operator --operation-id`。

## 策略

- `GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/policy`，租户由单一头或单一参数提供（PUT 也可由 body
  的 `tenant_id` 提供，来源须一致）。GET → `{tenant_id, rules}`（无策略
  `404`）；PUT body `{tenant_id, rules}` 整体替换；DELETE 幂等，→
  `{tenant_id, deleted:true}`。
- 规则元素 `{subject, actions, effect}`：`subject` 为区分大小写的非空字符串；
  `actions` 为非空数组，取值
  `create/read/rotate/revoke/import/export/audit`，单条内重复去重；`effect`
  为 `allow`/`deny`；未知字段、类型错误、同 subject+effect+无序动作集的重复
  规则均 `400`；`rules:[]` 合法（全拒绝）。
- 执行：管理动作 policy_* 免检；租户无策略时全部允许；有策略时匹配规则中
  deny 优先于 allow，无匹配则拒绝 → `403`，并记一条原动作名、
  `outcome=rejected`、携带当时已知 `key_id` 的事件（create/解密前的 import/
  audit 查询为 null）。参数校验先于授权，授权先于存在性判断。

## 审计

- 事件字段 `{event_id, tenant_id, action, key_id, outcome, timestamp}`；
  `action` 为 `create/read/rotate/batch_rotate/revoke/import/export/audit/
  tenant_conflict/policy_read/policy_update/policy_delete`，`outcome` 为
  `success/rejected`。备份记 `export`、恢复记 `import`，两者 `key_id` 均为
  null；恢复的所有事件（含成功）`key_id` 为 null；批量轮换整批至多一条
  `batch_rotate` 事件，成功与拒绝终态的 `key_id` 均为 null，可按
  `action=batch_rotate` 筛选。
- `GET /v1/audit`：单一租户来源；可选 `key_id`(UUID4)、`action`、
  `limit`(1–1000，默认 100)、`cursor`。→ `{events, next_cursor}`，按
  (timestamp, event_id) 升序；游标为 HMAC 签名令牌，绑定租户/筛选/快照，
  被篡改或条件变化为 `400`。查询成功不记账，被策略拒绝才记一条
  `audit/rejected`（key_id null）。
- 账本为数据目录 `audit.log`（每行一个 JSON，只追加，进程内锁 +
  `audit.log.lock` fcntl 串行并 fsync，seq 单调）。变更走 outbox 事务：密钥
  /策略文件先携带待提交事件原子落盘 → 耐久追加账本（提交点）→ 清标记；账本
  失败回滚文件并删除本次新建句柄，返回 `500`（CLI `1`）；崩溃后启动按标记/
  event_id 幂等补记或回滚，不重不漏。恢复是多文件 outbox（标记带
  `"_restore":true` 与写集清单），只追加一条 `import` 事件；批量轮换是多
  key outbox（标记带 `"_batch_rotate":true`、写集 key_ids 与 provision/
  snapshot 引用），只追加一条 `batch_rotate` 事件（`key_id` null）。

## 命令行

所有子命令除 `serve` 外都需 `--operator`，租户命令需 `--tenant-id`；输出为
单行 JSON，字段与对应 HTTP 响应一致。

```bash
# 密钥
python -m keymgr gen      --tenant-id t --algorithm RSA2048 --label k --operator alice
python -m keymgr show     --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr current  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
python -m keymgr version  --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --version 1 --operator alice
python -m keymgr rotate   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --algorithm AES256 \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key rotate-0001
python -m keymgr batch-rotate --tenant-id t --operator alice \
                          --idempotency-key batch-0001 \
                          --items '[{"key_id":"<id1>","algorithm":"AES256"},{"key_id":"<id2>","algorithm":"RSA2048"}]'
python -m keymgr revoke   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --reason r --operator alice
python -m keymgr status   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --operator alice
# 导出/导入、备份/恢复
python -m keymgr export   --tenant-id t --key-id <id> --passphrase pw --operator alice
python -m keymgr import   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key import-0001
python -m keymgr backup   --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --operator alice
python -m keymgr restore  --tenant-id t --passphrase pw --bundle <b> \
                          --operator alice --idempotency-key restore-0001
# 审计 / 操作 / 策略
python -m keymgr audit    --tenant-id t --action rotate --limit 100 --operator alice
python -m keymgr operation --tenant-id t --operator alice --operation-id <id>
python -m keymgr policy --operator admin set|show|delete --tenant-id t [--rules '<json>']
```

## KMS/HSM 提供者

- 工厂返回对象须有非空 `provider_id`、`capabilities`
  （algorithms 含 AES256/RSA2048；operations 含
  generate/rotate/import_material/export_material/delete）及这五个方法。
  generate/rotate/import_material → `{handle, public_key, encrypted_material}`；
  export_material(handle) → `{public_key, encrypted_material}`；delete(handle)
  幂等。模块缺失/工厂失败/契约不符/后端异常一律 `503`（CLI `1`），固定文案
  "key management provider is unavailable"，绝不回退；导入材料不符算法（AES
  非 32 字节、RSA 公私钥不匹配等）为 `400`，错误只指名字段。
- 本地提供者用 `local.dek`(0600) 以 AES-256-GCM 包装材料，句柄与包装材料登
  记在 `local-registry.json`(0600)；密钥文件每个版本只存
  `{provider_id, handle, encrypted_material}` 三元组，导出包/备份包版本额外
  带 `provider` 来源块，旧 `keymgr-export-v1` 包无来源块时按本地处理。
- 轮换/导出/导入/恢复必须命中记录登记的 provider：记录属于未激活提供者，或
  导入/恢复来源块与当前提供者不符，均 `503`，不静默切换。
- 启动时安全扫描旧记录：仅当本地提供者活动时，把裸 `private_material`/空句
  柄的旧版本校验并包装为本地对象，先包装后原子重写，失败保持原文件字节不
  变（新建句柄随即释放，不影响启动）；配置了外部提供者时启动与普通读取既不
  加载提供者也不改写旧记录（此类记录在导出/轮换时 `503`）。

## 持久化与限制

- 每个密钥为数据目录下 `<key_id>.json`（0600，fsync + 原子 rename），含
  append-only `versions` 与 `current_version`；轮换在 per-key 进程内锁 +
  `<key_id>.lock` fcntl 锁下读改写，并发不丢版本、不悬指针。
- 导入/恢复/批量轮换在提供者调用前先建按 event_id 命名的 provision journal
  （首行耐久记录 operation_id、租户与动作，每铸一个句柄即以 0600 原子重写登记
  provider_id 与句柄）；提交后句柄归记录所有并删除 journal，未提交（冲突、
  提供者故障、账本失败、崩溃）则幂等删除全部已铸句柄，不留孤儿后端对象。恢复
  依据 journal 头校验账本中同 id 事件确属本次操作（动作、租户一致）才判定已
  提交；不一致即保留全部现场等待处理。批量
  轮换另在 `batch-rotations/<event_id>.json` 耐久记录每个 key 轮换前的整文件
  字节（snapshot），未提交时据此把整组文件还原；snapshot 缺失则整组保留等待下
  次启动，绝不猜测改写。
- 旧 restore 记录可能没有 provision journal：未提交回滚时以 `_restore` 标记
  的密钥文件列出整组句柄；提供者不可达或任一句柄删除失败时，保留整组密钥文件、
  策略文件与标记，下一次启动重试，全部句柄确认删除后才移除整组文件。
- 私钥与口令只存在于口令加密的包内或经提供者包装后的记录中；游标 HMAC 密钥
  存于 `audit.secret`(0600)。材料不会出现在任何响应、审计投影或错误信息中。

1	"""Atomic tenant restore: multi-file outbox transaction over keys and policy.
2	
3	A restore writes several key files and optionally one policy document as a
4	single logical transaction. Every file first lands carrying the same pending
5	marker (the shared audit event plus a manifest of the whole write set); the
6	single audit event is appended to the ledger once; only then are the markers
7	cleared. A failure or crash at any point is repaired idempotently on the next
8	open, mirroring the per-key outbox in :mod:`keymgr.store` and the policy
9	outbox in :mod:`keymgr.policy`.
10	
11	Conflict rules, applied before anything touches disk:
12	
13	* a ``key_id`` that already exists for the requesting tenant is a ``409``
14	  (nothing is changed);
15	* a ``key_id`` owned by another tenant answers ``404`` so existence never
16	  leaks across tenants;
17	* a policy document already present for the tenant conflicts regardless of
18	  whether the bundle carries rules or an explicit null (an existing policy is
19	  never overwritten or deleted); a document on the tenant's hashed path that
20	  names another owner is treated as a foreign ``404``.
21	
22	An empty bundle (``keys == []`` and ``policy is null``) creates no files but
23	still commits the single ``import`` event and reports success.
24	"""
25	
26	import hashlib
27	import json
28	import os
29	import threading
30	from contextlib import contextmanager
31	from typing import Dict, Iterator, List, NamedTuple, Optional
32

34	from . import tenantbundle

93	        # policy write lock still guard individual files.

98	    # -- backup ------------------------------------------------------------
99	    def backup_payload(self, tenant_id: str) -> dict:
100	        """Build the decrypted tenant payload {format, tenant_id, keys, policy}.
101	
102	        The read runs under the tenant's policy lock and every key lock of
103	        the tenant (all acquired in the same sorted order the restore
104	        transaction uses), so the bundle is one committed view: a concurrent
105	        rotate/revoke/policy update in any process is either fully before or
106	        fully after the snapshot, never mixed into it.
107	        """
108	        key_ids = [r.key_id for r in self.store.list_for_tenant(tenant_id)]
109	        with self.policy_store.tenant_lock(tenant_id), self.store.multi_key_locks(

129	            for record in records:

154	        The in-process ``_restore_lock`` cannot stop a second server or CLI

156	        an exclusive ``fcntl`` lock on ``restore.lock`` can. A finite
157	        ``timeout`` bounds the wait (idempotent restore) and raises

159	        """
160	        import time as _time
161	
162	        from .store import LockTimeout

164	        if timeout is None:
165	            self._restore_lock.acquire()

180	        acquired = False

183	            if deadline is None:
184	                fcntl.flock(lock_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
185	            else:
186	                while True:
187	                    try:
188	                        fcntl.flock(lock_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)

190	                    except BlockingIOError:
191	                        remaining = deadline - _time.monotonic()
192	                        if remaining <= 0:
193	                            raise LockTimeout("restore")

196	            yield

203	    def _empty_marker_path(self, tenant_id: str) -> str:

210	    def _restore_locks(
211	        self,
212	        tenant_id: str,
213	        key_ids: List[str],

216	        """Acquire every lock a restore needs, before any handle is minted.
217	
218	        Order: the in-process + cross-process restore locks, the tenant policy
219	        lock, then the per-key locks in sorted order. With a finite
220	        ``timeout`` all acquisitions share one deadline (5 s for an idempotent
221	        operation); exhausting it raises LockTimeout before the provision
222	        journal, audit event or any provider handle exists.
223	        """
224	        import time as _time
225	
226	        entered = []
227	        deadline = None if timeout is None else _time.monotonic() + timeout
228	
229	        def remaining() -> Optional[float]:
230	            if deadline is None:

233	
234	        try:

308	                for one_key_id in key_ids:

311	                        if k["key_id"] == one_key_id
312	                    )
313	                    records.append(

316	                        )
317	                    )

319	                # Conflict scan only after every provider call succeeded.
320	                # Any foreign owner anywhere wins (404); otherwise a
321	                # same-tenant owner is a 409. Repeated under every lock.
322	                conflict = self._scan_conflicts(tenant_id, key_ids)
323	                if conflict is not None:
324	                    # Nothing was written; the finally block deletes every
325	                    # minted handle through the journal.
326	                    status = (
327	                        RESTORE_FOREIGN_CONFLICT

337	                    # batch still commits a persistent idempotency marker plus
338	                    # its single import event. The policy lock is already held
339	                    # by _restore_locks, so just inspect the path directly.
340	                    policy_path = self.policy_store.path_for(tenant_id)
341	                    if os.path.exists(policy_path):
342	                        owner = self.policy_store.owner_of_path(policy_path)
343	                        if owner is not None and owner != tenant_id:
344	                            return RestoreResult(
345	                                status=RESTORE_FOREIGN_CONFLICT,
346	                                conflict=Conflict(kind="policy", owner=owner),
347	                            )

349	                            status=RESTORE_SAME_TENANT_CONFLICT,
350	                            conflict=Conflict(kind="policy", owner=tenant_id),
351	                        )
352	                    result = self._commit_empty(
353	                        tenant_id, event, pre_commit=pre_commit
354	                    )

359	                    "_restore": True,
360	                    "event": event.to_json(),
361	                    "tenant_id": tenant_id,
362	                    "key_ids": key_ids,
363	                    "policy": writes_policy,

365	                    "journal": journal_id,

369	                # transaction without re-acquiring them. It removes the write
370	                # set on failure; the finally below owns handle cleanup.
371	                result = self._commit_locked(
372	                    tenant_id, key_ids, records, policy_rules, event, marker,
373	                    pre_commit=pre_commit,
374	                )

376	                    committed = True
377	                return result

379	                if committed:

381	                    # property; the journal is spent housekeeping.
382	                    self.store.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)
383	                else:
384	                    # Conflict, refusal, provider fault, validation or ledger
385	                    # failure: no success event committed. Reconcile the
386	                    # durable journal (it covers handles the frames above no
387	                    # longer hold). A backend delete that cannot be verified
388	                    # keeps the journal for startup and surfaces as 503
389	                    # instead of silently leaking a KMS/HSM object.
390	                    if not self.store.rollback_provision_journal(journal_id):
391	                        raise ProviderUnavailable(
392	                            "could not delete handles provisioned by an "
393	                            "aborted restore; cleanup will be retried at "
394	                            "startup"
395	                        )

397	    def _commit_empty(self, tenant_id: str, event: AuditEvent,
398	                      pre_commit=None) -> RestoreResult:
399	        """Commit an empty restore: idempotency marker + one import event.
400	
401	        The marker file first lands carrying the pending event, the event is
402	        appended, then the marker is finalized with the event cleared. A
403	        ledger failure removes the marker (nothing commits); a crash is
404	        repaired by recovery exactly like a multi-file restore group. The
405	        optional ``pre_commit`` runs between the durable marker write and the
406	        append so the idempotent result is staged before the commit point.
407	        """
408	        path = self._empty_marker_path(tenant_id)
409	        if os.path.exists(path):
410	            # This tenant already committed an empty restore batch.
411	            return RestoreResult(
412	                status=RESTORE_SAME_TENANT_CONFLICT,
413	                conflict=Conflict(kind="batch", owner=tenant_id),
414	            )
415	        marker = {
416	            "_restore": True,
417	            "_empty": True,
418	            "event": event.to_json(),
419	            "tenant_id": tenant_id,
420	            "key_ids": [],
421	            "policy": False,
422	        }
423	        self.store._write_atomic(path, marker)
424	        try:
425	            if pre_commit is not None:
426	                pre_commit()
427	            self.store.audit.append(event)
428	        except BaseException as exc:
429	            try:
430	                os.unlink(path)
431	            except OSError:
432	                pass
433	            if isinstance(exc, LedgerError):
434	                raise
435	            raise LedgerError(
436	                "tenant restore failed before commit: %s" % exc
437	            ) from exc
438	        finalized = dict(marker)
439	        finalized["event"] = None
440	        self.store._write_atomic(path, finalized)
441	        return RestoreResult(
442	            status=RESTORE_CREATED,
443	            tenant_id=tenant_id,
444	            key_ids=[],
445	            policy_restored=False,
446	        )

448	    def _scan_conflicts(
449	        self, tenant_id: str, key_ids: List[str]
450	    ) -> Optional[Conflict]:
451	        """Return the first conflict (foreign owners take priority).
452	
453	        A policy document already present for the tenant conflicts even when
454	        the bundle's policy slot is null: a restore never overwrites or
455	        deletes an existing policy.
456	        """
457	        same_tenant: Optional[Conflict] = None
458	        for key_id in key_ids:
459	            existing = self.store.read_raw(key_id)
460	            if existing is None:
461	                continue
462	            if existing.tenant_id != tenant_id:
463	                # A foreign key answers 404 immediately and suppresses any
464	                # same-tenant 409, so cross-tenant existence never leaks.
465	                return Conflict(
466	                    kind="key", owner=existing.tenant_id, key_id=key_id
467	                )
468	            if same_tenant is None:
469	                same_tenant = Conflict(
470	                    kind="key", owner=tenant_id, key_id=key_id
471	                )
472	        path = self.policy_store.path_for(tenant_id)
473	        if os.path.exists(path):
474	            owner = self.policy_store.owner_of_path(path)
475	            if owner is not None and owner != tenant_id:
476	                # The tenant's hashed path holds a document naming another
477	                # tenant; treat it like a foreign occupation.
478	                return Conflict(kind="policy", owner=owner)
479	            if same_tenant is None:
480	                same_tenant = Conflict(kind="policy", owner=tenant_id)
481	        return same_tenant
482	
483	    def _commit_locked(
484	        self,
485	        tenant_id: str,
486	        key_ids: List[str],
487	        records: list,
488	        policy_rules: Optional[List[Rule]],
489	        event: AuditEvent,
490	        marker: dict,
491	        pre_commit=None,
492	    ) -> RestoreResult:
493	        """Run the multi-file outbox transaction; caller already holds locks.
494	
495	        Only the file/policy write set is rolled back here; the caller's
496	        finally block owns reconciliation of the minted handles with the
497	        provision journal (which also covers handles held by records no
498	        longer in scope), so a delete failure is reported rather than
499	        swallowed.
500	        """
501	        # Re-scan now that every file lock is held.
502	        conflict = self._scan_conflicts(tenant_id, key_ids)
503	        if conflict is not None:
504	            status = (
505	                RESTORE_FOREIGN_CONFLICT
506	                if conflict.owner != tenant_id
507	                else RESTORE_SAME_TENANT_CONFLICT
508	            )
509	            # The provider objects were minted before the file writes, but no
510	            # file now commits; the outer finally deletes the handles via the
511	            # durable journal.
512	            return RestoreResult(status=status, conflict=conflict)
513	
514	        written_keys: List[str] = []
515	        wrote_policy = False
516	        try:
517	            # Phase 1: every file lands carrying the shared marker.
518	            for record in records:
519	                self.store.write_restore_pending(record, marker)
520	                written_keys.append(record.key_id)
521	            if policy_rules is not None:
522	                self.policy_store.write_restore_pending(
523	                    tenant_id, policy_rules, marker
524	                )
525	                wrote_policy = True
526	            # The write set is durable: let the caller stage the exact
527	            # idempotent result before the single commit-point append.
528	            if pre_commit is not None:
529	                pre_commit()
530	            # Phase 2: the single ledger append. The files are the outbox.
531	            # The durable append is the commit point.
532	            self.store.audit.append(event)
533	        except BaseException as exc:
534	            # Roll back every file/policy document the transaction created.
535	            self._rollback(written_keys, wrote_policy, tenant_id)
536	            if isinstance(exc, LedgerError):
537	                raise
538	            raise LedgerError(
539	                "tenant restore failed before commit: %s" % exc
540	            ) from exc
541	
542	        # Phase 3: clear the markers. The commit point already passed, so
543	        # this is best-effort housekeeping: a failure here or a crash is
544	        # repaired idempotently on the next open (event is durably in the
545	        # ledger, the restored data and its handles stay authoritative).
546	        for record in records:
547	            try:
548	                self.store.clear_restore_pending(record)
549	            except OSError:
550	                pass
551	        if policy_rules is not None:
552	            try:
553	                self.policy_store.clear_restore_pending(
554	                    tenant_id, policy_rules
555	                )
556	            except OSError:
557	                pass
558	        return RestoreResult(
559	            status=RESTORE_CREATED,
560	            tenant_id=tenant_id,
561	            key_ids=key_ids,
562	            policy_restored=policy_rules is not None,
563	        )

565	    def _rollback(
566	        self,
567	        written_keys: List[str],
568	        wrote_policy: bool,
569	        tenant_id: str,
570	    ) -> None:
571	        """Remove the file/policy write set of a restore that did not commit.
572	
573	        Provider-handle cleanup is intentionally not here: it is reconciled
574	        from the durable provision journal (restore()'s finally on the
575	        request path, or _recover_group on startup), so a failed backend
576	        delete keeps the journal and retries instead of being swallowed.
577	        """
578	        for key_id in written_keys:
579	            self.store.remove_file(key_id)
580	        if wrote_policy:
581	            self.policy_store.remove_restore_file(tenant_id)
582	
583	    # -- crash recovery ----------------------------------------------------
584	    def recover(self) -> None:
585	        """Finish or roll back restores interrupted by a crash.
586	
587	        Files still carrying the shared marker are grouped by the embedded
588	        event id. When the event reached the ledger the transaction commits
589	        (markers are cleared); otherwise it never committed and every file of
590	        the group is removed. Both paths are idempotent.
591	        """
592	        groups: Dict[str, _PendingGroup] = {}
593	
594	        def group_for(marker: dict) -> _PendingGroup:
595	            eid = marker["event"]["event_id"]
596	            group = groups.get(eid)
597	            if group is None:
598	                group = _PendingGroup(marker)
599	                groups[eid] = group
600	            return group
601	
602	        data_dir = self.store.data_dir
603	        try:
604	            names = os.listdir(data_dir)
605	        except OSError:
606	            names = []
607	        for name in names:
608	            if name.startswith(_EMPTY_MARKER_PREFIX) and name.endswith(".json"):
609	                self._recover_empty_marker(os.path.join(data_dir, name))
610	                continue
611	            if not (name.endswith(".json") and _is_uuid(name[:-5])):
612	                continue
613	            path = os.path.join(data_dir, name)
614	            record = self.store._read_record(path)
615	            marker = getattr(record, "pending_event", None)
616	            if not isinstance(marker, dict) or not marker.get("_restore"):
617	                continue
618	            group_for(marker).key_files[record.key_id] = path
619	
620	        policy_dir = self.policy_store.dir_path
621	        try:
622	            policy_names = os.listdir(policy_dir)
623	        except OSError:
624	            policy_names = []
625	        for name in policy_names:
626	            if not name.endswith(".json"):
627	                continue
628	            path = os.path.join(policy_dir, name)
629	            doc = self.policy_store._read_doc(path)
630	            if doc is None:
631	                continue
632	            owner, rules, pending = doc
633	            if not isinstance(pending, dict) or not pending.get("_restore"):
634	                continue
635	            group = group_for(pending)
636	            group.policy_file = path
637	            group.policy_tenant = owner
638	            group.policy_rules = rules
639	
640	        group_journals = {
641	            g.journal for g in groups.values() if g.journal
642	        }
643	        # A provision journal still owned by an unfinished batch-rotation
644	        # recovery (a surviving _batch_rotate marker or batch snapshot) is
645	        # resolved by KeyStore, which deletes every new handle and restores
646	        # every old file before dropping journal and snapshot together. Never
647	        # reap such a journal here independently, or the rollback's retry
648	        # basis (and its new handles) would be discarded halfway.
649	        group_journals |= self.store.batch_recovery_journal_ids()
650	        for eid, group in groups.items():
651	            if not self._recover_group(eid, group):
652	                # The ledger could not be read or a provider handle could not
653	                # be deleted: leave files and journal for a later open to
654	                # retry rather than risking committed material or orphaning a
655	                # backend object.
656	                continue

658	            # handle journal, deferred from the store's own startup sweep, is
659	            # now spent. On the uncommitted path _recover_group verified
660	            # every handle delete before returning True.
661	            self.store.drop_provision_journal(group.journal)
662	
663	        # Journals with no marker group (crash before the first file landed)
664	        # are swept last; their event never committed as a success.
665	        self._resolve_orphan_journals(skip=group_journals)

667	    def _resolve_orphan_journals(self, skip=()) -> None:
668	        """Reap provision journals left by restore attempts with no marker.
669	
670	        A crash after provider adoption but before the first file landed
671	        leaves a journal but no marker group. Only a durable ``success`` event
672	        means ownership transferred (which cannot happen without the marker
673	        group, handled in :meth:`recover`); with no event, or a durable
674	        ``rejected`` provider-failure terminal, every recorded handle is
675	        deleted. The journal is dropped only once all deletes succeed.
676	        Journals still tied to a marker group (including an unresolved one)
677	        are skipped.
678	        """
679	        directory = os.path.join(self.store.data_dir, "provisions")
680	        try:
681	            names = os.listdir(directory)
682	        except OSError:
683	            return
684	        for name in names:
685	            if not name.endswith(".json"):
686	                continue
687	            journal_id = name[:-5]
688	            if journal_id in skip:
689	                continue
690	            event = None
691	            try:
692	                event = self.store.audit.get_event(journal_id)
693	            except LedgerError:
694	                continue
695	            committed = (
696	                event is not None
697	                and event.outcome == audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS
698	            )
699	            if committed and self.store._journal_event_is_foreign_success(
700	                journal_id, event
701	            ):
702	                # A durable success carries this id but is not the attempt's
703	                # own event (action/tenant collision): park the journal for
704	                # resolution rather than adopting or reaping its handles.
705	                continue
706	            if not committed:
707	                if not self.store.release_journal_handles(journal_id):
708	                    # A backend delete failed: retain the journal so the next
709	                    # open retries, instead of silently leaking a handle.
710	                    continue
711	            self.store.drop_provision_journal(journal_id)
712	
713	    def _recover_empty_marker(self, path: str) -> None:
714	        """Resolve an empty-restore idempotency marker after a crash.
715	
716	        A finalized marker (``event`` is null) is the persistent record that
717	        the batch committed; it stays. A marker still carrying its pending
718	        event is finished when the event reached the ledger, and removed
719	        otherwise — both idempotently, mirroring multi-file recovery.
720	        """
721	        try:
722	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
723	                marker = json.load(fh)
724	        except (OSError, ValueError):
725	            return
726	        if not isinstance(marker, dict) or not marker.get("_restore"):
727	            return
728	        event = marker.get("event")
729	        if not event:
730	            return  # finalized marker: the committed batch's idempotency record
731	        try:
732	            durable = self.store.audit.get_event(event["event_id"])
733	        except (LedgerError, KeyError, TypeError):
734	            return  # leave it for a later open to retry
735	        committed = (
736	            durable is not None
737	            and durable.outcome == audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS
738	            and durable.action == audit_mod.ACTION_IMPORT
739	            and durable.tenant_id == marker.get("tenant_id")
740	        )
741	        if (
742	            durable is not None
743	            and durable.outcome == audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS
744	            and not committed
745	        ):
746	            # A same-id success event that is not THIS restore's event (an
747	            # action/tenant collision): neither finalize nor remove -- park
748	            # the marker for operator/startup resolution.
749	            return
750	        if committed:
751	            finalized = dict(marker)
752	            finalized["event"] = None
753	            self.store._write_atomic(path, finalized)
754	        else:
755	            try:
756	                os.unlink(path)
757	            except OSError:
758	                pass
759	
760	    def _recover_group(self, eid: str, group: _PendingGroup) -> bool:
761	        """Resolve one marker group. True if resolved, False to retry later."""
762	        marker = group.marker
763	        tenant_id = marker["tenant_id"]
764	        try:
765	            event = self.store.audit.get_event(eid)
766	        except LedgerError:
767	            # Leave the group untouched; a later open retries recovery.
768	            return False
769	        committed = (
770	            event is not None
771	            and event.outcome == audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS
772	            and event.action == audit_mod.ACTION_IMPORT
773	            and event.tenant_id == tenant_id
774	        )
775	        if (
776	            event is not None
777	            and event.outcome == audit_mod.OUTCOME_SUCCESS
778	            and not committed
779	        ):
780	            # A durable SUCCESS event carries this id but its action or
781	            # tenant does not match this restore: the id collides with a
782	            # different committed mutation, so neither "committed" nor
783	            # "roll back" is provable. Park the ENTIRE group -- every key
784	            # file, the policy document, the markers and the journal -- for
785	            # operator/startup resolution; delete nothing, finalize nothing.
786	            return False
787	        if not committed:
788	            # The commit-point success append never happened (event absent or
789	            # only a rejected terminal). Delete EVERY minted handle BEFORE
790	            # removing any file: with a journal the durable entry list is the
791	            # source of truth; an older group that predates restore journals
792	            # lists handles from the _restore-marked key files themselves
793	            # (a restore only ever creates brand-new keys, so every handle in
794	            # a landed group file belongs to the aborted batch). A provider
795	            # that cannot be reached, or a single delete that fails, keeps the
796	            # ENTIRE group -- every key file, the policy document and their
797	            # markers -- for a retry on the next open; nothing is partially
798	            # removed.
799	            handles_deleted = True
800	            if group.journal:
801	                if not self.store.release_journal_handles(group.journal):
802	                    handles_deleted = False
803	            else:
804	                for key_id, path in list(group.key_files.items()):
805	                    record = self.store._read_record(path)
806	                    if record is None:
807	                        continue
808	                    if not self.store.release_record_handles(
809	                        record, strict=True
810	                    ):
811	                        handles_deleted = False
812	            if not handles_deleted:
813	                return False
814	            # Only now, after every handle delete verified, are the files and
815	            # the policy document removed.
816	            for key_id, path in list(group.key_files.items()):
817	                self.store.remove_file(key_id)
818	            if group.policy_file is not None:
819	                self.policy_store.remove_restore_file(tenant_id)
820	            return True
821	        # Committed: finish the transaction by clearing the markers. This is
822	        # post-commit housekeeping and best-effort; a rewrite failure leaves
823	        # the marker for the next open and never rolls the data back.
824	        for key_id, path in group.key_files.items():
825	            record = self.store._read_record(path)
826	            if record is None or not record.pending_event:
827	                continue
828	            try:
829	                self.store.clear_restore_pending(record)
830	            except OSError:
831	                pass
832	        if group.policy_file is not None:
833	            try:
834	                self.policy_store.clear_restore_pending(
835	                    group.policy_tenant or tenant_id, group.policy_rules
836	                )
837	            except OSError:
838	                pass
